canonical_equations: bin=floor((time mod period)*bins/period); theta=(within_bin_SSE/(N-occupied_bins))/(global_SSE/(N-1)); bin means and both residual sums follow original observation order.
output_contract: F x [u32 status,f32 theta,global_variance,within_variance,u32 occupied_bins,u32 residual_dof]; status1 zero rounded global variance,2 fewer than2 occupied bins or no residual degrees of freedom; failed fields0. Lower theta is better; no overlapping covers/bin merging/automatic significance.
result_contract: F x [u32 status,f32 theta,global_variance,within_variance,u32 occupied_bins,u32 residual_dof]; status1 zero rounded global variance,2 fewer than2 occupied bins or no residual degrees of freedom; failed fields0. Lower theta is better; no overlapping covers/bin merging/automatic significance.
precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.

partition_strategy: trial periods with full ordered light curve; observations cannot be independently sharded without a new reduction contract
